title: Thread restriction failure when selecting count(*) of a table after truncate
body:
Reported by @robertpang.

```
cqlsh> select count(*) from location_data.location_data;

 count(*)
----------
    74743

(1 rows)
cqlsh> truncate location_data.location_data;
cqlsh> select count(*) from location_data.location_data;
NoHostAvailable:
```
